cards.name: Gundam Calibarn
cards.effect:
When one of your EX Resources is exiled from the game, you may choose 1 of your Units. During this turn, when it receives enemy damage, reduce it by 3.
【Deploy】Place 3 EX Resources.
cards.sourceTitle: Mobile Suit Gundam the Witch from Mercury

faqs.q: What does "reduce" mean?
faqs.a: It means to decrease the damage received. For example, when 3 damage is received and you are told to "reduce it by 1," that damage becomes 2.

faqs.q: When is the effect "When one of your EX Resources is exiled from the game" resolved?
faqs.a: If you use an EX Resource to pay the cost when playing a Unit, Pilot, or Base, resolve this effect at the same time effects such as 【Deploy】 and 【When Paired】 on that card resolve. If you use an EX Resource to pay the cost when playing a Command or activating an 【Activate･Main】 effect or similar, resolve this effect after the resolution of that card's effect.

faqs.q: If I have three EX Resources in play, how many EX Resources can I place with this 【Deploy】 effect?
faqs.a: You can place two, since the upper limit for EX Resources is five.

faqs.q: If there are multiple copies of this Unit in play, can each of those copies activate its effect during the same turn?
faqs.a: Yes. Each of them can activate its effect one time.

faqs.q: When there are two of these Units on my field, both of their first effects trigger and I choose one Unit when activating both "reduce it by 3" effects. At this time, can that Unit reduce damage received by a total of six?
faqs.a: Yes, it can reduce damage received by a total of six.

faqs.q: When there is one of these Units on my field, I use two EX Resources at once and exile them to pay a cost of two. At this time, does this Unit's first effect activate twice?
faqs.a: No. It only activates once.
